translation.title: Analgesic and Anti-inflammatory Plaster
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of stiff shoulders, low back pain, bruises, sprains, joint pain, muscle pain, chilblains, and pain from fractures.
translation.usage: Apply 1 to several patches a day to the affected area as appropriate.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: infants under 30 months of age; the area around the eyes; mucous membranes; eczema; dermatitis caused by lacquer or the like; wounded areas. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people who have experienced an allergic reaction (such as rash, redness or itching) from medicines or cosmetics; people with an allergic constitution; people with severe moist skin or erosion; people with a circulatory disorder or diabetes; children; women who are pregnant or may be pregnant; breastfeeding women. Follow the prescribed dosage and directions. When it is used by a child, use it under the supervision of a guardian. If your symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. If a large amount is absorbed through the skin, symptoms of poisoning may occur, so avoid using it on a large area for a long period. This medicine is for external use only. If the affected area is wet with sweat or the like, wipe it dry before use. Do not warm the area where the patch is applied with a hot pack, an electric blanket or the like. Bathing with the patch on causes strong irritation, so remove it 30 minutes to 1 hour before bathing. Skin that has already had a patch applied is weakened, so do not apply the patch repeatedly to the same spot. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: rash; redness; itching; swelling; occasionally severe itching or pain. Keep out of reach of children. Store at room temperature, protected from moisture and light.
